data.name: Kasish
data.gender_notes: Kasish is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Kas’, meaning ‘to know’ or ‘to acquire’. The name Kasish signifies one who possesses vast knowledge and wisdom. The name Kasish carries the meaning “Wisdom, Knowledge” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kasish usually hope their child will grow to embody wisdom, knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embrace knowledge and wisdom to enlighten your soul.
data.etymology: Kasish belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wisdom, Knowledge.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kasish total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
